findings.claim: Enum formatters use the inverse framework condition from every other template: the attribute is emitted only for NETSTANDARD2_0/NETFRAMEWORK and omitted on modern target frameworks. Consequently, enum generated code is not decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage for those targets.

receipt_plan.detail: Regenerate the source-generator snapshots for an enum formatter on a modern target (for example net8.0) and on netstandard2.0; verify that the modern output contains [global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] on the formatter and that EnumTemplate.cs and EnumTemplate.tt use the same condition.
